jobs.prompt: Three of the eleven disciples of Jesus (bearded Galilean fishermen in simple earthy-coloured tunics and mantles, different ages: one older broad-shouldered man with grey-streaked short beard, one young beardless man with curly hair, one man with a dark beard and headscarf) climbing together up a mountain path in Galilee at dawn. They look upward with hopeful, slightly nervous anticipation, one shading his eyes, one with a hand on his heart. Group waist-up.

The risen Jesus has just appeared on the mountaintop to his disciples. He stands radiant and calm, both arms slightly open in a gentle welcoming gesture, peaceful loving smile, looking slightly down toward the viewer who is kneeling before him. A subtle soft white rim light outlines his shoulders; his hair and beard keep their natural dark-brown colour.

Jesus declares: 'All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to me.' Majestic, solemn and serene. His right hand raised high pointing up toward heaven, his left hand open toward the earth. Strong steady gaze at the viewer. Warm light from above on his face.

Jesus sends his disciples: 'Go and make disciples of all the nations.' He sweeps his right arm outward, pointing far into the distance toward the horizon, his body slightly turned, his left hand resting encouragingly at chest level. Determined, encouraging, hopeful expression, looking toward where he points.

Jesus speaks about baptizing in the name of the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit. He holds a simple clay bowl of clear water in his left hand at chest height and raises his right hand in a gentle blessing over it. Eyes looking warmly at the viewer, solemn tender smile.

Jesus teaches: 'Teach them to obey everything I have commanded you.' He holds a small rolled scroll against his chest with his left hand and raises his right hand with the index finger lifted, explaining earnestly. Focused, kind, serious expression, mouth slightly open as if speaking.

Jesus promises: 'Surely I am with you always, to the very end of the age.' He places his left hand over his heart and reaches his right hand forward toward the viewer as if resting it on their shoulder. Deeply tender, reassuring smile, eyes full of love looking straight at the viewer.

Three of the eleven disciples of Jesus (bearded Galilean fishermen in simple earthy-coloured tunics and mantles, different ages: one older broad-shouldered man with grey-streaked short beard, one young beardless man with curly hair, one man with a dark beard and headscarf) setting out together on their mission. They walk forward side by side with confident, joyful, determined faces, wooden walking staffs in hand, travel bags on their shoulders, one smiling at the others, looking toward the wide world ahead. Group waist-up.
